intro: Tamil Nadu law against harassment of women in public spaces, transport, educational institutions, temples and workplaces. Overview — punishments were increased by a 2025 amendment, so check the current penalty.

sections.p: Any indecent conduct or act by a man that causes or is likely to cause intimidation, fear, shame or embarrassment to a woman — including abusing, teasing or making gestures — in public places, buses, trains, educational institutions, temples and other places of worship, cinemas, parks and beaches.

Harassment is punishable with imprisonment and fine. The original Act provided up to 3 years and a fine of at least ₹10,000; a 2025 amendment raised these. Harassment causing a woman's death or suicide is punished much more severely.

The person in charge of an educational institution, temple, cinema or vehicle (including bus conductors and drivers) must report harassment to police and help the victim. Failing to do so is itself punishable.
